key_path: Sign up for a Zoho account (email or Google/Microsoft/LinkedIn sign-in). Verify email; Indian signups typically also verify a mobile OTP
Pick the right data center (accounts.zoho.com / .in / .eu etc.). Every API host is DC-specific
API: go to api-console.zoho.com > Add Client > Self Client (or Server-based for redirect flow)
Generate a grant code with explicit scopes (e.g. ZohoCRM.modules.ALL), valid 3-10 minutes
POST to accounts.zoho.<dc>/oauth/v2/token to exchange for refresh_token + access_token (access token lasts 1h; refresh is long-lived)

MCP alternative: sign up at zoho.com/mcp > Create MCP Server > select Zoho/third-party apps and tools > authorize each app connection via OAuth > copy the server URL (https://<name>-<orgid>.zohomcp.com/mcp/<key>/message)
human_gates_notes: No card for free plans or trials. Grant-code generation in the API console is a manual UI step. 2FA (OneAuth) is often enforced by org admins. No regulatory gate for API use.

agent_native_auth.cli_login: partial. Zoho Catalyst CLI and the ZET (Zoho Extension Toolkit) CLI log in via browser, but there is no general 'zoho login' CLI that mints CRM/Books tokens
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: partial. The Zoho MCP server supports OAuth when added as a Claude custom connector (Claude detects the OAuth flow), and the URL also embeds a key
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes. OAuth scopes are granular per module/operation, and Zoho MCP servers expose only the tools you select
agent_native_auth.sandbox_test_credentials: yes for some products (Zoho CRM sandbox, developer edition, Zoho Books test orgs)
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes. Free plans/trials for most apps; Zoho MCP pricing page says no extra line item

remote.auth: secret key embedded in URL (treat like a password) and/or OAuth when added as a Claude connector

mcp.other: Per-product MCPs also exist (Zoho Analytics, Zoho Projects, Zoho Creator). Zoho MCP covers 500+ integrations incl. third-party apps
mcp.one_click_install: no deep links found; copy URL into the client

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: yes. https://www.zoho.com/llms.txt (company-level, links to per-product llms.txt such as /mcp/llms.txt, /analytics/llms.txt)
docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes for marketing/MCP pages (index.md, pricing.md, signup.md linked from /mcp/llms.txt); API docs themselves are HTML
docs_for_agents.openapi: Zoho CRM publishes OpenAPI specs on GitHub (zoho/crm-oas); not uniform across products
docs_for_agents.use_with_ai_page: Zoho MCP site + Creator Academy 'connect your Zoho MCP server to AI client' help article

score_justification: A real, cross-app hosted MCP builder and granular OAuth scopes, but key minting is manual (short-lived grant code), multiple DCs confuse agents, and the URL-embedded secret is a weak auth pattern.
best_practice: A user-composed MCP server: pick exactly which apps/tools an agent gets, so least privilege is set at server-creation time
biggest_gap: No CLI/device flow to mint API tokens, and the data-center-specific hosts (zoho.com vs zoho.in) are a common agent failure point
